eyebrow.zh: 计划审批 · 静态分析

headline.zh:
先看清计划，
再决定执行。
headline.en:
Inspect the plan.
Then decide to run.

sub.zh: agent-explain 把 Markdown 编码计划拆成逐步投影，在执行前列出 token 估算范围、动作词计数、风险标签和引用文件。
sub.en: agent-explain turns Markdown coding plans into step-by-step projections of token ranges, action-verb counts, risk labels and referenced files before execution.

caption.zh: 先看清计划，再决定执行

body.zh: 读、写、删除等关键词产生不同风险等级，复核时可以直接定位相应步骤。
body.en: Keyword rules label reading, mutation and destructive actions so a reviewer can inspect individual steps.

body.zh: 有可读文件时采样文件大小，否则保留文本估算，并输出 sampled 或 static。
body.en: Readable files contribute byte-size samples; otherwise the result remains text-based and reports its basis.

body.zh: JSON 保留逐步投影和总量，你的审批工具决定如何使用这些信息。
body.en: JSON preserves step projections and totals; your approval tool decides how to use them.

title.zh: 批准前，需要知道计划会做什么。
title.en: Know what the plan proposes before approval.

body.zh: 一份自然语言计划可能把读文件、修改代码和删除配置混在一起。agent-explain 把它拆成有序步骤，让估算范围、文件引用和规则风险一起出现。
body.en: A natural-language plan can mix file reads, edits and deletion. agent-explain separates its steps and shows estimated ranges, referenced paths and rule-based risk together.

body.zh: 自带例子只分析 Read、Edit 和 Delete 三步。它读取 auth.py 的大小，不执行修改或删除；结果为低、中、高风险各一步。
body.en: The supplied example analyzes Read, Edit and Delete steps. It samples auth.py size without modifying or deleting it, and reports one low-, medium- and high-risk step.

body.zh: parser 识别步骤与路径，analyzer 结合 token_est 和 risk_rules，projector 汇总，再交给 renderer 输出。
body.en: The parser extracts steps and paths, the analyzer combines token estimation and risk rules, and the projector aggregates results for rendering.

body.zh: 支持 Markdown 输入、可选本地文件大小采样，以及终端表格和 JSON 输出。不提供 Agent 执行器或自动审批服务。
body.en: Use Markdown input, optional local file-size sampling, and terminal or JSON output. The package does not provide an agent executor or approval service.

body.zh: CLI 优先按计划文件所在目录解析路径，再尝试原路径。常规文件按字节数估算；未找到文件时继续使用文本依据。
body.en: The CLI resolves paths relative to the plan directory first, then tries the original path. Regular-file sizes contribute estimates; missing files leave a text-only basis.

body.zh: tool_call_count 统计不同动作词，不是实际 API 调用次数。confidence 是固定的规则值，不是经过校准的成功概率。
body.en: tool_call_count counts distinct action verbs, not observed API calls. Confidence is a fixed rule value, not a calibrated probability.

note.zh: v0.6.0 的三步构造计划实际 JSON 输出。数字是启发式投影；没有运行 Agent 或执行计划动作。
note.en: Actual v0.6.0 JSON output for a constructed three-step plan. Values are heuristic projections; no agent or planned action ran.

body.zh: 两步引用已有 auth.py，一步引用不存在的 obsolete.json；总量为 15–60 token、3 个动作词、2 个不同路径。
body.en: Two steps reference the existing auth.py and one names absent obsolete.json: 15–60 estimated tokens, three action verbs and two distinct paths.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。安装依赖和首次加载 tokenizer 资源可能联网，投影过程不调用模型。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. Installation and initial tokenizer resource loading may need network access; projections do not call a model.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/agent-explain.git
cd agent-explain
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

limitations.zh: 风险由英文关键词规则决定，未识别的动作可能归为 low；审批方仍需阅读计划。
limitations.en: Risk uses English keyword rules; unrecognized actions may default to low. Reviewers must still read the plan.

limitations.zh: token 范围与动作词计数不是模型成本、真实调用数或安全性的保证。
limitations.en: Token ranges and action-verb counts do not guarantee model cost, actual calls or safety.
